title: 钟，不等地球了？
title_en: The Clock Stops Waiting for Earth

segments.en: You'll never see it again.
The clock isn't broken.

segments.zh: 是全世界刚投票取消了闰秒。
segments.en: The world just voted to scrap the leap second.
The General Conference on Weights and Measures decided:
from May 20, 2027, no more leap seconds.

segments.zh: 今天的问题：钟和地球对不上，
segments.en: Today's question: clocks and Earth disagree.
Why stop waiting for Earth?
Meet Little Earth.
One spin is one day.

segments.zh: 再认识小铯，原子钟里的铯原子，
segments.en: And Little Cesium, the atom inside an atomic clock:

segments.zh: 一秒振动九十一亿多次。
segments.en: over 9.1 billion wiggles a second.
The best cesium clocks
wouldn't lose a second in 300 million years.
Since 1967, the length of a second
has been set by cesium.

segments.zh: 问题来了：小铯从来不偷懒，
segments.en: Here's the problem: cesium never slacks,
but Earth speeds up and slows down.
The Moon's tides act like brake pads,
slowly dragging Earth down.
Melting ice flows toward the equator,

segments.zh: 就像滑冰的人张开胳膊，转得更慢。
segments.en: like a skater opening her arms and slowing down.

segments.zh: 地核晃一晃、刮几场大风，
segments.en: A wobble in the core, a few big winds,

segments.zh: 一天的长短也会差几毫秒。
segments.en: and a day changes by milliseconds.
So a day
isn't exactly 86,400 seconds.
So what do you do when they drift apart?
In 1972, people invented the leap second.
When the clock gets ahead of Earth,

segments.zh: 就在午夜多插一秒，等等地球。
segments.en: add one second at midnight and let Earth catch up.
It's been done 27 times,

segments.zh: 最近一次是2016年最后一天。
segments.en: most recently on the last day of 2016.

segments.zh: 每次都是全世界同一时刻，
segments.en: Each time, the whole world
waits that extra second at the same moment.
Twist one:
that one second wrecked computers.
Computers count to 59.

segments.zh: 突然冒出个60秒，直接懵了。
segments.en: Suddenly there's a 60, and they freeze.
In the 2012 leap second,

segments.zh: 好几家大网站和航空公司订票系统都出了故障。
segments.en: big websites and an airline booking system broke.
On New Year's Day 2017,

segments.zh: 一家大型网络公司也因为闰秒短暂出错。
segments.en: a major internet company glitched because of one.

segments.zh: 有的公司干脆发明了“抹秒”，
segments.en: Some companies invented the leap smear,

segments.zh: 把这一秒摊进一整天里。
segments.en: spreading that second across a whole day.
5G towers, power grids, stock trades:
they can't afford a messy second.
Twist two:

segments.zh: 地球这几年反而转快了！
segments.en: lately, Earth has been spinning faster!
People even started talking about
taking a second away for the first time.

segments.zh: 负闰秒就是直接跳过一秒，
segments.en: A negative leap second skips a second entirely.

segments.zh: 从来没人试过，谁也不敢试。
segments.en: Nobody has ever tried it, and nobody wants to.

segments.zh: 原本估算2026年前后就得减一秒，
segments.en: One estimate said we'd need it around 2026.

segments.zh: 冰川融化把它推迟到了2029年前后。
segments.en: Melting ice pushed that back to around 2029.
So the decision: stop adding them,
and let the clocks just tick.
The allowed gap between clock and Earth
grows to 3600 seconds. A full hour.

segments.zh: 反转三：那太阳会不会越来越不准？
segments.en: Twist three: will the Sun drift off schedule?
Yes, too slowly to notice.

segments.zh: 按近几十年的速度估算，
segments.en: At the pace of recent decades,
filling that hour would take over a thousand years.
In other words, that hour

segments.zh: 留给几百上千年后的人去操心。
segments.en: is a problem for people centuries from now.

segments.zh: 一辈子下来，太阳也就晚个把分钟，
segments.en: In a lifetime, the Sun might run a minute or so late.
You'd never feel it.
Navigation satellites relax too:

segments.zh: 不用再处理闰秒，换算少出错。
segments.en: no leap seconds means fewer conversion errors.

segments.zh: 说到底，是两种时间在打架：
segments.en: In the end, it's two kinds of time fighting:
Earth time and atom time.
Before, the clock waited for Earth.

segments.zh: 以后是钟先走，地球慢慢跟。
segments.en: Now the clock walks on, and Earth follows slowly.

segments.zh: 友情提示：天文学家用的世界时还在，
segments.en: Friendly fine print: astronomers' Earth time still exists,
and the Sun still rises in the east.

segments.zh: 这事也不影响你的闹钟，
segments.en: Your alarm clock won't notice either.
Your phone still syncs itself.
So the last 23:59:60
stays forever in 2016.

segments.zh: 小地慢慢转，小铯一秒不差，
segments.en: Earth spins at its own pace, cesium never misses,

segments.zh: 从此各走各的，相安无事。
segments.en: and from now on, they each go their own way.

elements.text: 几百上千年后的人去操心
以后：钟先走，地球慢慢跟
